summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under Chapter 19B of the Listing Rules. The filing reports no movements in authorized or issued share capital for May 2026; authorized share capital remained at USD 1,000,000 across three classes, and issued Class A and Class B ordinary shares were unchanged. It includes a public float sufficiency confirmation. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing, not a special situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring.
